reviews.text: We love our fence!  Highly recommend Thomas and his crew - they did fantastic work that exceeded our expectations!  Thomas truly cares about his work and it’s so hard to find such great level of craftsmenship  customer service these days!
reviews.author: Yes Ma’am

reviews.text: Podleski Construction was a breeze to work with. Their work is top of the line. I love my new patio!  Great communication, and worked in the timeline as promised. I highly recommend them to anyone who needs construction work.
reviews.author: Melissa Stacey

reviews.text:
We couldn’t be happier with our new fence! Thomas and his crew did an amazing job! They listen and are easy to work with. They take pride in their work!
The fence looks so good and has already made such a difference in our yard! I love it!!!
I highly recommend Podleski Construction to anyone needing a new fence!
reviews.author: Jessica Jimenez

reviews.text:
I recently hired Podleski Construction to install a wooden fence in my backyard, and I couldn't be more satisfied with the experience. From start to finish, their team was professional and attentive. The quality of the wood used was excellent, and the craftsmanship of the installation was evident in every detail. They were also very communicative throughout the process, addressing all my questions promptly.

The project was completed on schedule, and the final price was very reasonable considering the quality of work. Additionally, they provided valuable tips on maintaining the fence to ensure it lasts for years to come. Overall, I highly recommend Podleski Construction for anyone looking for reliable and high-quality fencing services. I would definitely hire the again.
reviews.author: Cayce

reviews.text: I needed a fence sooner than I had planned. I called several companies and Podleski Construction was the only one that provided a prompt quote & installation date with a reasonable price. They completed the job in one day and it looks great! I would use them again and highly recommend them.
reviews.author: MarkH

reviews.text:
Wow. That might be the easiest way to provide feedback.

(TLDR: if you need work done, hire Thomas and his team)

Thomas took this job that started with a couple what I’d say was standard requests (idk, I’m not a landscaper! Haha). “Hey can you just double check the sprinkler system?” and “can you update the flower bed and lay sod?”

You see, my yard was 90% dirt from a tree that we had removed from choking out all the grass that was once there.

When he started working on the sprinkler system, he found issue after issue after issue.

This estimated two day project very quickly turned to three, then four days. He kept in communication the whole time. Very professional!

Now to give my feedback:

I keep going and just standing and looking at it. My neighbors keep telling me that it looks amazing. Trust me when I say, these photos do not do justice. It looks incredible! When my partner and I started talking about his project we thought it would cost an arm and a leg. When the sprinkler started giving issue after issue we got a bit wide eyed, but the price was beyond fair for the work (to be honest, it was probably too fair in our favor!)

Thank you Thomas! We’ll make sure your number is saved for our future needs!
reviews.author: Nathan Packer

reviews.text: Thomas and his team were easy to work with. They kept in constant communication throughout the project, were very professional. Overall the fence turned out beautifully and we will definitely use them again if the need ever arises!
reviews.author: The Stiefer Fam

reviews.text: Podleski Construction came and did a great job replacing my very large steel gate post. Everything went just as he said it would in spite of the rain. They work hard and have high standards and a great eye for detail. The fair price was well worth it. Give them a try if you need work done.
reviews.author: Mark Cannon

data.summary: The reviews are highly detailed, varied, and mention specific projects and personnel, which strongly suggests authenticity. The lack of any critical reviews or presence on other platforms is a minor concern, but not a definitive red flag for a smaller, locally-focused contractor with a stellar reputation.
fake_signals: Perfect 5.0 rating with 56 reviews is statistically unusual
All reviews are 5-star with no critical feedback
authentic_signals: Reviews contain specific details (e.g., 'wooden fence', 'patio', 'Thomas and his crew')
Mentions of specific positive attributes like communication, timeliness, and craftsmanship
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only significant review presence is on Google, which shows a perfect 5.0 rating. No contradictory ratings from other platforms were found.
